page: Microsoft Azure D48nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel processors providing 48 vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core, intended for workloads requiring consistent multi-threaded computational resources alongside proportional memory capacity.

The hardware configuration includes 2,835 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, offering high-throughput, low-latency local disk operations directly attached to the host. In addition to local scratch space, the instance supports Azure Premium Storage for persistent storage volumes. The instance belongs to the network-optimized Dndv6 series, contains zero GPUs, and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By incorporating large integrated NVMe storage into a balanced general-purpose compute envelope, the instance avoids the I/O cost overhead of managing high-churn ephemeral data on external network block storage. The system is well structured for database workloads, transactional platforms, big data analytics, distributed caching tiers, and enterprise back-end services that demand high-speed local disk buffering and dedicated multi-core compute throughput.
